item.tib: mkha' 'gro dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi gsang ba ye shes thun mong du bsgrub thabs lcags kyu 'bar ba
item.coloph: ces mkha' 'gro gsang ba ye shes kyi thun mong du bsgrub pa'i bsnyen sgrub las sbyor gnad kyis (kyi) man ngag zab mo lcags kyu 'bum phrag 'bar ba'i 'phreng zhags 'di/ gnas chen g.yung drung spungs rtse'i byang phyogs/ ke'u seng ge yongs rdzongs (rdzong) nyi ma rang shar gyi ke'u tshang du/ snyigs ma'i rnal 'byor 'ja' tshon snying po rtsal gyis me 'brug zla tshes su brtsams pa dge legs dar rgyas 'phel bar shog
